overview.name: Jovie
overview.description: Find an artist and draft their Jovie page and release smart link. Nothing is published.
examplePrompts: Find Radiohead on Spotify and set up a Jovie draft for them.
Set up a release page and smart link for this single: https://open.spotify.com/track/25dMCbj0duxuvx5T8ClCp3
Which of these artists named Nova is the right one? Show me the candidates.
Resume the Jovie draft I started earlier for this artist.
What is still missing before this release draft is ready to review?

technical.accessRequirements: None. No account or API key is needed to connect.

tools.name: artist.search_or_import
tools.title: Find artist
tools.description: Resolve a public Spotify/Apple artist identity or return ranked name candidates. Select an exact ID before drafting. Returns a private, seven-day draft_token; retain it for workspace.create_draft. Creates no account and does not publish.

tools.name: workspace.create_draft
tools.title: Create artist draft
tools.description: Create or resume an unpublished visibility draft using the exact artist_id and draft_token from artist.search_or_import. Retrying the same token resumes the same draft; a token for another artist is rejected. Returns claim_url: show it to the user so they can sign in on Jovie and claim the draft; the artist is matched to its Spotify identity and stays private until the user publishes. Never share draft_token. Never claims ownership, publishes or purchases.

tools.name: release.prepare_launch
tools.title: Prepare release launch
tools.description: Resolve public release facts and create or resume an unpublished artist, release-page, and smart-link draft. Requires the draft capability. Returns only unresolved questions plus claim_url; when next_action is send_user_claim_url, show claim_url to the user so they can claim it on Jovie, where it stays private until they publish. Never claims, publishes, or purchases.

tools.name: claim_handle
tools.title: Claim a handle
tools.description: Check and reserve the draft artist’s jov.ie handle (the profile URL). Returns availability with numbered suggested alternatives when taken. High-reach artists are routed to the existing verification path. The reservation completes when the artist signs in through claim_url; nothing is public until they publish.

tools.name: answer_onboarding_question
tools.title: Record a Mom Test answer
tools.description: Record one onboarding Mom Test answer on the draft: lastGrowthAttempt (the artist's most recent growth attempt and how it went) or promoSpend (what they pay each month to promote their music, one of none, under_50, 50_plus). The exact question wording ships in the Jovie skill. Ask in your own voice; never lead or ask willingness-to-pay.

tools.name: get_qualification
tools.title: Get qualification
tools.description: Run the shared onboarding qualification for the draft artist. Returns qualified or queued with a reason; queued carries the locked line "Your handle is reserved. You're on the waitlist."

tools.name: build_profile
tools.title: Build profile preview
tools.description: Build the draft profile from the artist's public data, including the real catalog preview when available. Read-only preview for the artist; nothing is published.

tools.name: publish_profile
tools.title: Publish profile
tools.description: Publish step. Agents never publish: show claim_url so the artist signs in on Jovie and publishes from their dashboard. Returns claim_required until the draft is claimed.

tools.name: share_profile
tools.title: Share a profile
tools.description: Return the public jov.ie profile URL plus a factual share line for an already-public profile. Never shares a private or unpublished profile.

tools.name: start_upgrade
tools.title: Start upgrade
tools.description: Return the existing Jovie checkout entry for the draft artist (claim/start). Plans and prices are shown on Jovie from offer truth; never state a price yourself.
